title: Bartsch to Müller, 3 January 1631
author: Jacob Bartsch
summary: Bartsch laments Kepler's death at Regensburg, 'the sun of all astronomers', and tells of a fruitless fortnight at Gitschin trying to get Wallenstein to pay Kepler's salary and keep the press going.

notes.note: The Romans marked unlucky days with a black stone and lucky ones with a white.
A play on Kepler's *Somnium*, his dream of a journey to the moon, which was then being printed.
Jičín in Bohemia, the seat of Kepler's patron Wallenstein, Duke of Friedland.
